notes_for_editor: Thin: the only source is the tnlandforms Georgia list, which gives a number, coordinates, county and elevation for GA136 and nothing about the structure. Its name 'chester' is the compiler's own label (towers 73+). Two web searches for a Chester tower returned nothing specific. The cached NHLR Georgia list (29 lookouts) and FFLOS Georgia former-sites list (2 sites) name no Chester tower. Nothing found about build date, design, height, staffing, fate, or the site today. Dodge County entries nearby in the same list (GA041 O'Barr, GA135 'dodge') were not checked against this point and should not be conflated with it. Worth a human look: a Georgia Forestry Commission tower inventory or a Dodge County history might give the structure's history.
